source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Before Claude can get started, the following design specifications are needed:

Token sheet — define colors in hex with their background, text, border, and accent uses; provide the type scale with family, weight, size, line-height, and tracking for each style; and include the spacing scale, radii, and border widths.

Font files — supply the .woff2 files, the exact family names, and the weights that are actually in use.

Confirmed max content width — provide a single number so the container cap can be set precisely.

value_updates.maximum_content_width_specification: Provide one confirmed numeric maximum content width for precise container sizing.
